survey.help: The questionnaire: header, version, sections with their questions, options, rows and conditions.

lang.help: The language of the exported file: German or English.

anonymous.help: Anonymous: answers carry no recipient, even when the file was made for a recipient.

sections.help: The sections of the questionnaire in their order, each with heading, explanation, conditions and questions.

questions.help: The questions of the section in their order.

text.help: The question as respondents read it.

required.help: Required: without an answer the questionnaire cannot be completed.

noAnswer.help: Offers a "No answer" choice per row.

importance.help: Also asks for the importance from 1 to 9 per row.

multiline.help: Multi-line answer field instead of a single line.

options.help: The options of a single or multiple choice question.

group.help: The display group of an option in multiple choice; options of the same group stand together.

rows.help: The rows of a rating or Kano question.

recipients.help: The recipients with name, organisation, group, e-mail and note, plus when and with which version they got their file.

name.help: Name of the person or company.

group.help: The group the response rate is split by.

email.help: E-mail address, to send the file with your own mail program.

sentAt.help: When the file for the recipient was made and with which version of the questionnaire.

responses.help: The imported responses: per answer file the version, the recipient if known and not anonymous, the time and the answers per question.

recipientId.help: Who answered: the recipient, anonymous or without recipient.

answeredRecipientIds.help: Which recipients have answered; this gives the status not sent, sent or answered.

transfers.help: What was handed over: the answers taken into the VoC tree and per Kano question the Kano instance it goes to.

ui.help: The settings of the results: the filter (question and option, or empty), the grouping (single choice question or empty) and whether the report names the authors of free texts (reportWithNames; no effect for an anonymous questionnaire). Settable via instance.set.

filter.help: The filter of the results: a choice question and one of its options; empty counts all responses. Set via setFilter.

groupBy.help: The single choice question whose options the results are compared across; empty for no comparison. Set via setGroupBy.

reportWithNames.help: Whether the exported report names who wrote the free texts. No effect for an anonymous questionnaire.

dirtyStructure.help: Whether the structure changed since the last export; once the questionnaire was sent, the next export then raises the version.

exportedOnce.help: Whether the questionnaire was exported at least once.

results.help: The evaluation as the results tab shows it: under the active filter (filter) and grouping (groupBy). n is the number of responses after the filter; the response rate always covers all recipients. Per question the figures, plus the ranking of rating questions, the Kano overview, the free-text summary and — with a grouping set — the group comparison.

read.help: Read the questionnaire, recipients, imported responses, hand-overs and the state of the interface.

setHeader.help: Set a text field in the header of the questionnaire: title, introduction or contact.

params.field: title (the title above the questionnaire), intro (the introduction under the title) or contact (whom respondents contact with questions).
params.command: The command as one object with field and value.

setSurveyLanguage.help: Set the language of the exported questionnaire and response file: German or English.

params.command: The command as one object with lang.

setAnonymous.help: Switch whether the questionnaire is anonymous: responses then carry no recipient, even if the file was built for a recipient.

params.command: The command as one object with anonymous.

addSection.help: Append an empty section to the end of the questionnaire. Questions always sit in a section.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

setSectionField.help: Set the title or the hint of a section.

params.field: title (the heading of the section) or hint (an explanatory text under the heading).
params.value: The new text; empty clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with sectionId, field and value.

moveSection.help: Move a section one place up or down. Conditions that would then point at a later question are removed; the return value counts them.

params.command: The command as one object with sectionId and direction.

removeSection.help: Delete a section with its questions, without asking. Conditions on these questions are removed; the return value counts them.

params.command: The command as one object with sectionId.

addQuestion.help: Append a question of a type to a section and select it.

params.type: single (single choice), multi (multiple choice), rating (rating 1–5), kano (Kano pair), text (free text) or info (text only).
params.command: The command as one object with sectionId and type.

moveQuestion.help: Move a question one place up or down; at a section boundary it moves into the neighbouring section. Conditions that would then point at a later question are removed; the return value counts them.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId and direction.

removeQuestion.help: Delete a question, without asking — also when imported responses answered it. Conditions on it are removed; the return value counts them.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId.

setQuestionField.help: Set the text or the hint of a question.

params.field: text (the question as respondents read it) or hint (an explanatory text under the question).
params.command: The command as one object with questionId, field and value.

setQuestionFlag.help: Set a switch of a question. Which switches exist depends on the type; a switch the type does not have is rejected.

params.flag: required (required question: the questionnaire cannot be completed without an answer), other (additionally offers a free answer Other), noAnswer (offers the answer “no answer” per row), importance (additionally asks the importance from 1 to 9 per row) or multiline (multi-line answer field instead of one line).
params.on: true switches it on, false off.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId, flag and on.

changeQuestionType.help: Change the type of a question. Text, hint, required and conditions stay, options, rows and switches start empty; conditions on its previous options are removed.

params.type: The new type, values as for addQuestion.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId and type.

addItem.help: Append an empty option (single and multiple choice) or row (rating, Kano) to a question.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId.

setItemField.help: Set the text of an option or row, for multiple choice also the display group of an option.

params.field: text (the text of the option or row) or group (the display group of an option in a multiple choice; options of the same group stand together).
params.value: The new text; empty clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId, itemId, field and value.

moveItem.help: Move an option or row one place up or down within its question.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId, itemId and direction.

removeItem.help: Delete an option or row, without asking. Conditions on a deleted option are removed; the return value counts them.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId and itemId.

setConditions.help: Decides when a section or question appears: as soon as one of the named options was chosen in an earlier single or multiple choice question. Each condition suffices on its own; without a condition it always appears.

params.conditions: Per condition { questionId, optionIds }: an earlier single or multiple choice question and at least one of its options; [] removes all conditions.
params.command: The command as one object with nodeId and conditions.

markExported.help: Record the questionnaire as exported: if the structure changed after it left the house, the version goes up. Returns the valid version. The export tasks call this themselves.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

addRecipient.help: Add an empty recipient. Each recipient gets their own questionnaire file, whose answers identify the recipient.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

setRecipientField.help: Set a field of a recipient: name, organisation, group, e-mail or note.

params.field: name (name of the person or company), organisation (organisation or department), group (the group the response rate is split by), email (e-mail address to send the file with your own mail program) or note (a free note).
params.value: The new text; empty clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with recipientId, field and value.

removeRecipient.help: Delete a recipient, without asking. Their responses are kept, without a recipient.

params.command: The command as one object with recipientId.

markSent.help: Marks a recipient as sent without building a file — when the file arrived another way. This records the current questionnaire version: if the structure changes later and the next export raises the version, this recipient's file counts as outdated.

params.command: The command as one object with recipientId.

importResponse.help: Read in an answer file the questionnaire saved on the recipient's side. Files of this questionnaire are taken in, also those of an older version; a file read before, one of another questionnaire or a broken one only shows in the log.

params.json: The content of the answer file as text.
params.fileName: The name shown in the log.
params.command: The command as one object with json and fileName.

removeResponse.help: Delete an imported response, without asking; its VoC take-over marks go with it.

params.command: The command as one object with responseId.

setFilter.help: Narrow the evaluation to the responses that chose a given option in a single or multiple choice question. Without a filter all responses count.

params.questionId: The choice question; null together with optionId null lifts the filter.
params.optionId: One of its options; null lifts the filter.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId and optionId.

setGroupBy.help: Compare the evaluation across the options of a single choice question, for example by customer group. Groups with few responses are marked.

params.questionId: The single choice question; null switches the comparison off.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId.

setKanoTarget.help: Choose which Kano instance of the project a Kano question is handed to, or a new one.

params.instanceId: A Kano instance of the project; null creates a new one at the next hand-over.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId and instanceId.

setKanoTransfer.help: Record which Kano features and respondents a Kano question created in the chosen Kano instance. The hand-over sets this itself; by hand only for repairs.

params.transfer: { instanceId, itemIds, respondentIds }: the Kano instance, the features created and the respondents created.
params.command: The command as one object with questionId and transfer.

markVocTaken.help: Record answers as taken into the VoC tree without handing anything over. The takeover sets this itself.

params.keys: Answer keys <responseId>:<questionId>, with the suffix :other for an Other answer.
params.command: The command as one object with keys.

buildSurveyFile.help: Builds the general questionnaire (without recipient) as an HTML file and returns file name and content. Like the export it settles the version.

cancel.help: Cancels the build; the version stays unchanged.

buildRecipientFile.help: Builds the personal questionnaire file of a recipient and returns file name and content. Like the export it settles the version and marks the recipient as sent.

cancel.help: Cancels the build; the recipient stays as it was.

params.command: The command as one object with recipientId.

buildReport.help: Builds the report of the results under the active filter and grouping as an HTML file and returns file name and content. The export in the html format produces the same file; the task downloads nothing.

toWorksheet.help: Create all responses as a new worksheet in this phase, one row per response. Returns the instance of the worksheet.

cancel.help: Cancels the hand-over; nothing half-done remains.

takeToVocTree.help: Take the ticked free texts and Other answers into the VoC tree of the project as customer voices; if there is none, one is created. Answers already taken can be taken again. Returns the number of answers taken and the instance of the tree.

cancel.help: Cancels the takeover; nothing is recorded.

params.keys: Answer keys <responseId>:<questionId>, with the suffix :other for an Other answer; the ids are in read().responses.
params.command: The command as one object with keys.

handOverToKano.help: Hand over a Kano question with all its responses, without filter, to the chosen Kano instance or to a new one in this phase. A repeated hand-over replaces only what came from this question. If it fails midway, everything stays unchanged. Returns the Kano instance.

cancel.help: Cancels the hand-over; nothing half-done remains.

params.command: The command as one object with questionId.

selectedSectionId.help: The selected section in the draft, empty without selection. A pure view; it is not saved.

conditionDraft.help: The draft of a new condition for the selected section or question: source and options. setConditions takes it over. A pure view; it is not saved.

importLog.help: The log of the answer files read in this session: per file the name, whether it was taken in or rejected, and the notes on it. A pure view; it is not saved.

expandedResponses.help: The ids of the responses whose details are expanded. A pure view; it is not saved.

rankingOpen.help: Whether the ranking of the rating questions is expanded. A pure view; it is not saved.

vocSelected.help: The answer keys of the free texts ticked for the VoC tree. takeToVocTree takes them over. A pure view; it is not saved.

kanoRev.help: A counter that rises with every change to the Kano instances of the project so that the hand-over selection list is rebuilt. A pure view; it is not saved.

ResponseRate.sent: How many recipients got their file.
ResponseRate.rate: Response rate: answered divided by sent.
ResponseRate.withoutRecipient: Responses imported without a known recipient.

OptionStat.share: Its share of the responses to the question.

RatingStatRow.n: How many responses count for the row.
RatingStatRow.dist: How often each level from 1 to 5 was chosen.
RatingStatRow.na: How often no answer was chosen.

KanoStatRow.counts: How many answers fall into each Kano category M, O, A, I, R and Q.
KanoStatRow.n: How many responses count for the row.
KanoStatRow.unanswered: How many answers could not be classified.
KanoStatRow.category: The Kano category of the row, determined from the answer pairs.
KanoStatRow.tie: Whether several categories are equally frequent.
KanoStatRow.cs: Satisfaction coefficient: how much the feature delights when present, from 0 to 1.
KanoStatRow.ds: Dissatisfaction coefficient: how much its absence annoys; the larger the magnitude, the stronger.
KanoStatRow.importanceN: How many answers carry an importance.

TextEntry.responseId: The response the text comes from.

QuestionStat.type: The question type; it decides which of the following parts appear.
QuestionStat.n: How many responses saw the question, that is under the filter and with its condition met.
QuestionStat.answered: How many of them answered (single and multiple choice).
QuestionStat.options: The options with count and share (single and multiple choice).
QuestionStat.otherCount: How many answers carry an Other text.
QuestionStat.rows: The rows with their figures (rating and Kano).

RankingRow.n: How many responses count for the row.

KanoRow.category: The Kano category of the row, determined from the answer pairs.
KanoRow.cs: Satisfaction coefficient: how much the feature delights when present, from 0 to 1.
KanoRow.ds: Dissatisfaction coefficient: how much its absence annoys; the larger the magnitude, the stronger.
KanoRow.n: How many answers could be classified.

FreeTextSummary.total: How many free texts and Other texts there are.
FreeTextSummary.taken: How many of them are already in the VoC tree.

GroupComparison.questionId: The single-choice question used for grouping.
GroupComparison.groups: The groups with their response count; few marks few responses.
GroupComparison.questions: Per compared question the shares, means or categories per group.

SurveyResults.filter: The active filter of question and option, otherwise empty.
SurveyResults.groupBy: The active grouping question, otherwise empty.
SurveyResults.n: How many responses remain after the filter.
SurveyResults.responseRate: The response rate; the filter does not change it.
SurveyResults.questions: The figures per question in questionnaire order.
SurveyResults.ratingRanking: All rating rows, by mean descending.
SurveyResults.freeText: How many free texts there are and how many are taken over.
SurveyResults.groupComparison: The comparison per group; empty without a grouping.
